title: Northgate Protect Accident Claims: Credit for Prompt Reporting
content:
A prompt-report credit comes off the claim service fee on a Northgate Protect Accident-tier claim: the next-day credit of $15.00 when the decided claim was filed no more than 1 day after its incident date, the week credit of $5.00 when it was filed two to 7 days after, and nothing when it was filed later. The days are calendar days from the incident date the plan holder reported on the claim to the date the claim was filed.

## Ladder in figures

| Days from incident date to filing date | Credit |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | $15.00 |
| 2 to 7 | $5.00 |
| 8 or more | Nothing |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical dates)

| Incident date | Filing date | Days | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 July | 14 July | 0 | $15.00 |
| 14 July | 15 July | 1 | $15.00 |
| 14 July | 16 July | 2 | $5.00 |
| 14 July | 21 July | 7 | $5.00 |
| 14 July | 22 July | 8 | Nothing |
